reviews.text: I cannot emphasize enough how thankful I am for Dr Soderstrom and his entire staff! My Romeo was suspected of having Insulinoma after taking him in for a routine dental cleaning back in July and discovered he had abnormally low blood sugar. Further testing confirmed it was insulinoma. Scan showed one tumor that was removed by Dr Soderstrom that following August. His surgery went great! Staff stayed in contact with me for his overnight stay after surgery and always available for any questions or concerns. Romeo has been doing great! Highly recommend Dr Soderstrom and Soderstrom Veterinary Surgery! 10/10 experience.

Do not take your dog to this vet for surgery. The veterinarian is not board certified. And when I spoke to the receptionist about it, she was extremely rude. And hung up on me.

You can check the reviews, but they take advantage of people on a regular basis. Thank god I did my research before bringing my dog here.

This guy should be put in jail for performing surgeries he's not certified to do.

This is my personal experience as a client with this veterinary service. If I could give zero stars, I would.

BIG thank you to Dr.Soderstrum & the entire staff for helping us through a super difficult time when our Lexi dog had a serious ankle surgery. The staff was attentive, caring & competent. We are so grateful and would recommend them wholeheartedly! Much love & many blessings!

Dr. Sodistrum and the entire staff have been absolutely amazing. He performed surgery on my French Bulldog, Gemma, to remove a tumor from her spleen, and because of his skill and care, we were blessed with 4 extra wonderful months with her before the cancer returned. I do not regret doing the surgery for a second.

Now he is helping me care for my other Bulldog, and once again the compassion from this office has been incredible. You can truly tell they care about both the animals and the people who love them. The entire team is kind, caring, and supportive in a way that feels very different from the cold experience you often get at corporate vet offices.

I highly recommend Dr. Sodistrum and his staff to anyone looking for a veterinarian who genuinely cares and provides exceptional care.

Dr. Soderstrom is truly exceptional. Our French bulldog developed Valley Fever that affected his heart and required major surgery. After a very stressful experience elsewhere, finding Dr. Soderstrom was a blessing.

He is calm, incredibly knowledgeable, and personally communicated with us throughout the entire procedure—which meant everything during such a scary time. His team, including the overnight nurse, was kind and very informative.

Not only was the care outstanding, but the cost was also fair and reasonable. Today, our boy has healed beautifully and looks like a happy puppy again.

We are beyond grateful and highly recommend Dr. Soderstrom to anyone facing a serious situation with their pet.
My on-going experience with Mark, Whitney and Peggy is tremendous and highly recommend their clinic.
Puppy had heart surgery and a leg bone taken care of. They saved her life. I met the surgeon and thanked him and gave him a hug. So appreciative of all they did. Fabulous crew there.

Seems a bit unethical for staff not to notify people that Dr soderstrom no longer performs total hip replacement surgery after it was explained over the phone initially that the consult would be for a potential hip replacement specifically...especially for  $125!!!
Dr. Mark Soderstrom was so awesome and compassionate. I would highly recommend him.

Took our older Ridgeback here for two-part (major) abdominal surgery.  The first thing we observed is that the facility is CLEAN, well-thought-out, and organized. The doctor and staff were very present at all times and understood the mental space we were in. They patiently and compassionately managed our expectations.  The entire staff exudes calm competence. From start to finish, we knew exactly what to expect and when. I had full confidence in Dr Soderstrom & his team and they executed the surgeries successfully. Post-op care was absolutely solid and the two weeks to stitch-removal went smoothly, with them quickly addressing our questions as we managed his recovery. If your pet needs surgery, this is where you want to take them. Huge thanks to everyone there.

Brought my mom here her Pomeranian has a fractured paw, she’s tiny so the vet decided to cast her leg, instead of doing an expensive surgery she seems to be doing well, the vet is straight foward and explains everything clearly and the staff is very nice! Peggy is very nice and efficient
Dr Soderstrom and and his team did a great job for our cat. Thank you for you.! Gila says thank you all!

Simply the best! We can count on them when things are going very wrong in our world and know that we will be receiving the very best of care for our babies.  Life was just up ended with an IVDD emergency and surgery was done immediately(same day) to prevent further damage. That's pretty amazing in our opinion. We aren't even close to being out of the woods but I know we will continue to have all their support to get us there. Thank you guys so very, very much!
The Smathers family!

Dr Soderstrom is the best! My cat has had a mystery illness for a year. He has been so kind and patient in helping me help my poor kitty. I feel so lucky to have been referred to him. His office staff is also kind and amazing. It has made a stressful time so much more tolerable. Thank you Dr. Soderstrom and staff!

Identified the issue with the anal glands as an autoimmune issue and did not perform surgery  in spite of having an open surgical time slot. Great communication and great personality. $165 instead of $4K and hope of management of the issue in 10 days.

Had to take my fur baby for knee surgery.  The availability of appoint and surgery date was convenient and quick. The doctor and staff have a great personality and great customer service.  The $$$ was reasonable dis not break the bank. My fur baby recovered very well and back to her normal self. Thank you Dr. Soderstrom.
The best I’ve ever been to! Totally thorough without taking unnecessary extra time AND goes the extra mile! Love Soderstrom!
Dr. Soderstrom and his team are amazing!

Working with Dr Soderstrom and his team has been the best experience!! They got our lil Frenchie in right away and the surgery was half the price other places quoted me. They called me frequently to give updates and I felt they cared for her as if she was their own. A staff member even took her home one night so she did not have to be in the clinic unattended. I am BEYOND grateful for every member of the Soderstrom team!! Highly, highly, recommend!!

Absolutely do not recommend. One: You can never get a real person on the phone 100% of the time you call.  What you get is Peggy's Voicemail, you leave a message to only never hear back and to have to leave another message.  Our dog Charlie has an injury to his leg, so we went for a surgery consult with Soderstrom.  Soderstrom said it had nothing to do with his leg and that Charlie had a Brain Tumor, so we bought into it and paid $1600 for a CT of the brain. After the CT was done we never heard back from him on the results, until I called several times 3 weeks later.   Finally hear back from Soderstrom who says the CT was negative and then says Charlie has fluid around his brain, so lets put him on Prednisone for 3 days and I'll call you back in 3 days to see how he's doing.  AGAIN, NO CALL BACK this was 2 weeks ago and after I left several messages on Peggy's voice mail and still no call back. In fact when I tried to tell Soderstrom that this is a leg injury he appeared over the phone to get frustrated with me, telling me he knows what he's talking about.  My thoughts. . Well, I to do and nothing Dr. Soderstrom has done has turned up any answers. The issue is I accidentally stepped on my dogs hind leg in the middle of the night, it was dark and I didn't see him. I felt how hard I stepped on him, not once but twice. When he moved I moved and I stepped on him again. I tore the meniscus in my knee from this accident when I lost my balance trying to get away from him and not hurt him again. Just be very careful proceeding with this vet. He doesn't return calls and he may lead you down a path of financial hardship with no results. We are starting over with a new surgeon today and I hope Charlie can get the attention and care he needs.

This team took great care of my yellow Labrador when she experienced a ligament tear and needed surgery. Communication, procedure, value, and after care were all great. Safe, friendly, professional, and competent.

Dr Soderstrom is the best. He genuinely cares about his patients and their families. Our dog needed emergency surgery and he gave a very honest prognosis, giving us the ability to make an informed decision about proceeding with the surgery. …

My chihuahua Duke recently went in for grade 4 luxating patella surgery and I can't say enough great things about the experience with Dr Soderstrom and his staff. Great people to work with and my dogs recovered really well from surgery.

Soderstrom Veterinary Surgery doesn’t deserve even one star. Terrible! Unprofessional! Doesn’t care what happens to your pet once paid. Almost lost my dog after the doctor performed an ACL procedure. I contacted him when I realized I had a …
Great Doctor, great staff, and excellent care of our pet.   Highly recommended!!
Excellent care from a wonderful staff, thank you all so much!
